{{Quote|From his humble beginnings as a Podracer in the Outer Rim, Kerd has traveled the galaxy. He's flown for every major race team, from SoroSuub to the Hutt Racing Program, and has turned down more sponsorships than Master Lanius has turned down interview requests from yours truly&mdash;which says something.|[[Yara Grugara]], on Kerd K'Kerren|<ref name="Swoop and Dive">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040506|text=Swoop and Dive}}</ref>}}
The '''Hutt Racing Program''' was a major [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] team. The [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] [[Kerd K'Kerren]] flew for the team at some point during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
